column1: 90-DAY LAUNCH | SEQUENCED GATES, NOT A MANDATE TO LAUNCH SIX TITLES

column4: Interview 15 students, 5 parents, 5 teachers and 4 shops. Collect actual competing books. Confirm medium and board/year.
column5: Interview notes; competitor shelf sheet; source/rights register.
column6: No claim that an Instagram poll proves demand.

column4: Complete remaining interviews; test two free chapter prototypes, price cards and real book pages; obtain 3 like-for-like print quotes.
column5: Two approved prototypes; costed specification; tax/privacy review started.
column6: Discovery/prototype spending cap INR 60,000 until gate passed.

column4: Lock two Class 10 titles and one medium. Define 8-paper pagination and all printed solutions. Design first 3 free chapters by diagnostic value.
column5: Signed syllabus map and manuscript plan; no unreviewed 'official' claims.
column6: Stop a title that cannot be accurately completed before promised delivery.

column4: Build reusable diagrams and vertical Reel templates; publish 4–5 Class 10 Reels and free lesson 1 per title.
column5: Track qualified visits and question attempts, not only plays.
column6: No paid reach boost merely because a Reel gets views.

column4: Continue manuscripts/videos; implement checkout, entitlement database, refund/coupon rules and guardian flow.
column5: Test payment webhook and free viewing without forced registration.
column6: No third-party behavioural pixels on student learning pages.

column4: Finish six free lessons; test on low-cost phones; prepare teacher specimen and short book walkthrough. Recruit permissioned partners.
column5: Academic review; low-data/mobile test; partner terms.
column6: No covert teacher commission or compulsory pupil purchase.

column4: Blind-review representative papers and all prototype solutions; compare printer proofs; approve tax/invoicing/access terms.
column5: Print-ready proof and approved unit economics.
column6: Accept transparent preorders only against a credible dispatch date.

column4: Complete the paid catalogue promised for launch and the first two print masters; test scratch-code sequence and two-device recovery.
column5: Release candidate books/videos; duplicate-redemption and refund tests.
column6: Do not sell all-chapter access while undisclosed major chapters are missing.

column4: Authorize only the first short batch against paid demand/partner commitments. Test dispatch to urban and rural pincodes.
column5: Real courier-weight data; delivery tracking; receipt/activation checklist.
column6: Check actual per-SKU print price and latest viable dispatch date.

column4: Fulfill pilot buyers; repair activation friction; collect voluntary learning feedback; seed 10–20 outlets with capped stock.
column6: No further ad scale while refund or academic issues remain.

column4: Promote best-converting Reel families; launch disclosed referral pilot; compare digital-only vs bundle paths.
column5: Contribution by cohort/channel; 3/7-day support and refund metrics.
column6: One reward/commission path per sale; no incentive stacking.

column4: Reconcile all channels and printer stock; test second order/subject bundle; set reprint by demand and lead time.
column5: Actual CAC, sell-through, margin, cash and partner receivables.
column6: Do not print ahead merely to obtain a cheaper unit quote.

column4: Review academic outcomes and financial gate. Continue, revise price/offer or stop. Class 12 expansion only after title-level approval.
column5: Next-season plan; corrections log; source and customer-data audits.
column6: Expansion requires positive contribution, dependable delivery and evidence of learning.
